events.title: Two-route SFTP stage then CSV to SQL
events.summary: We split SFTP pickup from CSV parsing and SQL insert so we can archive and stage files in between.
events.detail: Route 1 only polls SFTP, archives the raw CSV, and stages a local copy. Route 2 polls the stage folder, parses CSV, maps to SQLXML, and inserts.
events.rationale: We split SFTP pickup from CSV parsing and SQL insert so we can archive and stage files in between.
alternatives: Single route: SFTP Listener directly into CSV, XSLT, and DatabaseSqlTransport

events.title: JSCH encrypted SFTP (not plain FTP)
events.summary: We use encrypted SFTP with JSCH instead of cleartext FTP.
events.detail: Host/port/user/password and poll directory come from environment-settings $$ tokens so compose can remap without editing modules.
events.rationale: We use encrypted SFTP with JSCH instead of cleartext FTP.
alternatives: DirectoryListener on a host-mounted drop folder only (no remote SFTP)

events.title: Restrict SFTP poll to .csv and delete after pickup
events.summary: Only CSV files are picked up, and the remote file is deleted after a successful poll.
events.detail: Only CSV files under the remote upload directory become transactions. After a successful poll the remote file is deleted so the same file is not re-ingested every 10 seconds.
events.rationale: Only CSV files are picked up, and the remote file is deleted after a successful poll.
alternatives: PostProcess Move to a remote done/ folder
Leave files on the server and rely on name uniqueness only

events.title: Archive raw CSV before staging
events.summary: We keep an immutable raw copy on disk before any transform.
events.detail: Archive names keep the original FileName attribute plus a millisecond suffix so ops can compare what arrived vs what SQL received.
events.rationale: We keep an immutable raw copy on disk before any transform.
alternatives: Skip archive and only keep the staged copy
Archive only after successful SQL insert

events.title: Stage locally for DirectoryListener handoff
events.summary: Route 2 only watches the local stage folder, so SFTP pickup stays separate from SQL processing.
events.detail: Route 2 does not talk to SFTP at all — it only watches the local stage folder. That isolates network pickup from database latency.
events.rationale: Route 2 only watches the local stage folder, so SFTP pickup stays separate from SQL processing.
alternatives: In-memory handoff via TransactionAttribute / callout instead of files

events.title: CSV Dialect A with header row
events.summary: CSV to Dialect A XML with headers on, so column tags come from the header row.
events.detail: PilotFish CSV Transformation emits XCSData/XCSRecord Dialect A. With headers on, column tags are UPPERCASE names from the CSV header (for example PATIENTID), which the XSLT must match.
events.rationale: CSV to Dialect A XML with headers on, so column tags come from the header row.

events.title: Custom route XSLT csv-to-sqlxml.xslt (Saxon)
events.summary: A custom stylesheet maps those columns into SQLXML inserts for dbo.CsvPatients.
events.detail: The stylesheet maps Dialect A PATIENTID/FIRSTNAME/… elements into SQLXML insert statements for dbo.CsvPatients. Engine is Saxon.
events.rationale: A custom stylesheet maps those columns into SQLXML inserts for dbo.CsvPatients.
alternatives: Hand-authored SQLXML in a custom Processor module
DatabaseSqlTransport with a static Query instead of SQLXML from XSLT

events.title: JDBC SQL Server via environment tokens
events.summary: SQL inserts go to database CsvSftpDemo over JDBC, with connection settings from environment tokens.
events.detail: Target database CsvSftpDemo on Docker service sqlserver:1433. Credentials stay in environment-settings.conf so modules stay portable across stage/full compose.
events.rationale: SQL inserts go to database CsvSftpDemo over JDBC, with connection settings from environment tokens.
alternatives: HTTP API façade in front of the database

events.title: External systems for this demo
events.summary: SFTP (host sftp:22, user demo, dir upload) and SQL Server (CsvSftpDemo).
events.detail: Host-mapped ports: SFTP localhost:2224, SQL Server localhost:14341. Web UI 8133, EIP 8132.

events.title: Route 1: SFTP poll CSV to stage
events.summary: Published diagram for 1 - SFTP Poll And Stage
events.detail: Modules: Poll SFTP for CSV → Archive Raw CSV → Write Staged CSV.

events.title: Route 2: CSV to SQLXML to insert
events.summary: Published diagram for 2 - CSV To SQL
events.detail: Modules: Poll Staged CSV → CSV to XML → Map CSV XML To SQLXML → Insert Patients SQL.
